import openpyxl
import os

# Load the spreadsheet
spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/160-6/1_160-6_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/160-6_0_7e17a9c0/1_160-6_output.xlsx"

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)

# Load workbook
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb['SH']

# The answer_position is 'SH'!A6:L11, which means rows 6-11
# We need to remove blank rows from this range and shift data upward

# First, identify which rows in the range 6-11 are blank
blank_rows = []
for row_idx in range(6, 12):  # rows 6-11 (inclusive)
    row_values = [ws.cell(row_idx, col).value for col in range(1, 13)]  # columns A-L (1-12)
    if all(v is None for v in row_values):
        blank_rows.append(row_idx)

print(f"Blank rows found in range 6-11: {blank_rows}")

# Now we need to shift non-blank rows upward to fill the gaps
# We'll work within the range A6:L11
target_row = 6  # Start filling from row 6

for source_row in range(6, 12):  # Check rows 6-11
    # Check if this row is blank
    row_values = [ws.cell(source_row, col).value for col in range(1, 13)]
    is_blank = all(v is None for v in row_values)
    
    if not is_blank:
        # This row has data, copy it to target_row if different
        if source_row != target_row:
            for col in range(1, 13):  # columns A-L
                ws.cell(target_row, col).value = ws.cell(source_row, col).value
        target_row += 1

# Clear any remaining rows in the range after the last filled row
for row_idx in range(target_row, 12):
    for col in range(1, 13):
        ws.cell(row_idx, col).value = None

print(f"Data compacted. Filled rows: 6 to {target_row-1}")
print(f"Cleared rows: {target_row} to 11")

# Save the workbook
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Saved to {output_path}")
